title: A Busy Week and a Good Rest
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须使用原文中的词，不超过字数限制。所有解释为中文，证据为原文引用。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A Busy Week and a Good Rest

(A) Lin is a Chinese adult learner. He works in an office and studies English at night. This week is very busy because he has a big test on Friday. He feels tired, so he goes to bed early on Monday. On Tuesday, he drinks two cups of coffee because he needs energy. But coffee is not a good habit at night. He should drink water, not coffee, before bed.

(B) Lin's friend, Mei, is a nurse. She works long hours, so she is often tired. Mei says, "You should sleep seven or eight hours every night. Sleep is the most important thing for health." Lin thinks about her words. He should also exercise more. Walking is good, but running is better for his heart. However, running is the most tiring exercise for him. He decides to walk for 30 minutes every day.

(C) On Wednesday, Lin goes to bed at 10 p.m. He puts his phone in the kitchen because the light from the phone is bad for sleep. He sleeps for eight hours. On Thursday, he feels better and studies for two hours. He is not the best student in his class, but he is happier than before. On Friday, he takes the test. He is tired but calm. After the test, he rests and drinks water. He knows that good habits are more important than coffee.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示原因，so 表示结果。should 表示“应该”，用于给建议。比较级用于两者比较，如 better；最高级用于三者或以上比较，如 the most important。
grammar.example: This week is very busy because he has a big test on Friday.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Lin is tired, ______ he goes to bed early.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: He feels tired, so he goes to bed early on Monday.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ drink water before bed.
questions.evidence: He should drink water, not coffee, before bed.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: Running is ______ than walking for his heart.
questions.explanation: 两者比较用比较级 better。
questions.evidence: Walking is good, but running is better for his heart.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: Sleep is the ______ important thing for health.
questions.explanation: 三者或以上比较用最高级 the most important。
questions.evidence: Sleep is the most important thing for health.
